comment:
* Custom progress bar that shows a cycle of colors as widening circles that
 * overdraw each other. When finished, the bar is cleared from the inside out as
 * the main cycle continues. Before running, this can also indicate how close
 * the user is to triggering something (e.g. how far they need to pull down to
 * trigger a refresh).

variables.name: COLOR1
variables.comment: Default progress animation colors are grays.

variables.name: ANIMATION_DURATION_MS
variables.comment: The duration of the animation cycle.

variables.name: FINISH_ANIMATION_DURATION_MS
variables.comment: The duration of the animation to clear the bar.

variables.name: INTERPOLATOR
variables.comment: Interpolator for varying the speed of the animation.

variables.name: mColor1
variables.comment: Colors used when rendering the animation,

methods.name: void setColorScheme(int color1, int color2, int color3, int color4)
methods.comment:
* Set the four colors used in the progress animation. The first color will
     * also be the color of the bar that grows in response to a user swipe
     * gesture.
     *
     * @param color1 Integer representation of a color.
     * @param color2 Integer representation of a color.
     * @param color3 Integer representation of a color.
     * @param color4 Integer representation of a color.

methods.name: void setTriggerPercentage(float triggerPercentage)
methods.comment:
* Update the progress the user has made toward triggering the swipe
     * gesture. and use this value to update the percentage of the trigger that
     * is shown.

methods.name: boolean isRunning()
methods.comment: * @return Return whether the progress animation is currently running.
